extracted_data.description: Green Co-Financing Loans - Ελληνική Αναπτυξιακή Τράπεζα ESG Tracker by HDB: Δημιουργήστε δωρεάν αναφορά για την επιχείρησή σας en Ελληνικά ( Greek ) Previous Programs Green Co-Financing Loans Green Co-Financing Loans The Green Co-Financing Loans Fund was established to provide favorable terms regarding investment loans to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), offering 40% of the capital interest rate-free and a two-year partial interest subsidy upon the Financial Intermediary’s interest rate for the remaining 60% of the capital, for the implementation of Green Transition investment projects. Investment projects regarding Green Mobility, Energy Efficiency/Energy Upgrades, and Energy Production through Renewable Sources are supported.
